title: Compute the factorial of a number using recursion
hint: Define the base case as n at most 1 returning 1, and otherwise return n multiplied by factorial(n - 1).

title: Print the Fibonacci series using recursion
hint: Use recursion where fib(n) returns n for n less than 2, else fib(n-1) plus fib(n-2), and loop to print each term; memoize to avoid repeated work.

title: Generate all permutations of a string
hint: Backtrack by fixing one character at each position, swapping or using a used array, recursing, and undoing the choice after returning.

title: Generate all subsets (the power set) of a given set
hint: At each element branch into include or exclude via backtracking, or iterate bitmasks from 0 to 2^n minus 1.
